data.one_liner: Sanitizes HTML to prevent XSS exploits by restricting elements and attributes to a safe subset.
data.what_it_does: It parses HTML into an in-memory DOM tree and filters elements and attributes to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) exploits and avoid interference with the host page. It removes inline JavaScript, CSS, forms, and other potentially dangerous elements, following rules similar to GitHub Flavored Markdown sanitization.
use_when: You need to embed untrusted HTML safely in a website or app
You are rendering user-generated markdown or HTML content
avoid_when: You need to allow custom inline CSS or complex HTML structures
You require a non-strict HTML sanitizer that preserves most styles and scripts
strengths: Strict filtering to safeguard against XSS attacks
Modeled after robust GitHub Flavored Markdown sanitization rules
weaknesses: Very strict, completely disallows CSS properties
Not documented for non-standard HTML extensions
